page.notes: The "de" at the end of the first line and "affert" before "judicium" carry a long flourish after the word; I read it as a line-end stroke, not a letter. The long s in "fusius" and "Samaritis" is read as s. The final "pre-" is a fragment and stays a fragment. No catchword is printed below the last line.
